user_saw: With newline chunking enabled, formatted Signal replies could combine paragraphs in one message and split later paragraphs by length.
summary: The fix applies the effective chunk mode to formatted Signal sends and groups paragraphs before splitting by rendered length.
reasoning: At the oldest available checkout snapshot, outbound delivery already routed formatted Signal replies around the plain-text chunker, and the Signal formatter accepted only the length limit and table mode. The older path history stopped at a missing object, so I could not verify when the bypass first shipped or whether formatted replies had previously honored newline mode.
